meta.recordPolicy: Real-world business identity/contact/address fields are copied from CSV where present. All operational records and missing commercial attributes are synthetic assumptions.
meta.important: Do not treat synthetic prices, hours, equipment, activation status, staff, customers, reservations or payments as facts about the real businesses. Confirm business permission before onboarding.
meta.passwordPolicy: passwordHash is null. Generate hashes in seed.ts with the same password hasher used by the application; never store plaintext passwords in this JSON.
meta.phonePolicy: All generated customer/staff phone numbers are marked synthetic test data. Verify they cannot receive OTPs or contact real people before using an SMS provider.
meta.prismaCompatibility: Portable JSON seed specification, not guaranteed to match Prisma model field names or enum definitions until checked against schema.prisma.
